- EU sovereign mirroring (primary in eu-west1, synchronous mirror for auditable residency)
- APAC warm-standby for regional spikes (cold-to-warm seeding, expected warm traffic in Q1)

Maria

- Capacity: we'll size steady-state and two-tier peak (we'll draft numbers after the team reviews the CSV).

Subject: Internal: Draft sizing & commercial approach for WellCare renewal

Folks — brief internal note before David circles back to Maria. I reviewed the CSV overnight. Key recommendations:

1) Sizing
- Steady-state tokens: baseline ~1.6k units/day (from CSV p90).
- Provision for 2x peak headroom = plan for ~3.2k units/day equivalent. Suggest we propose a 2-tier reserved capacity: 2.0k reserved (eu) + 1.5k burstable pool (cross-region).
- EU dedicated footprint: 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs (quantized model lanes) + two hot standby nodes for mirror replication.

2) APAC seeding approach
- Phase 1 (30 days): cold-seed a single APAC cluster sized at 25% of EU steady-state, KV warmers run daily.
- Phase 2 (60–90 days): ramp to 50% with periodic canary traffic and a scheduled warm-up window preceding major events.

3) Failover & SLAs
- Recommend active-passive with regional read-fallback caching and a warm-KV rehydration window (target 90s for full KV warm, read fallback meets 5s metadata SLO).
- Add an ops playbook step: global traffic drain test during the first month post-cutover.

4) Commercials / Terms
- Offer: 24-month term with a one-time onboarding credit equal to 20% of month-1 reserved cost if they commit to the 2.0k reserved in EU.
- Pricing: blended per-token charge for cross-region reads; add explicit line for inter-region data transfer & replication (the usual cost recovery).
- Add an optional addendum for KMS-managed encryption (+30 day lead time).

Next actions: Karthik/Monica to draft SOW line items (capacity + canary windows + transfer costs). Ben to confirm pricing cadence & credits. David will align with Maria on the meeting time and share the draft SOW/DocuSign link.

Laura
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Maria — thanks again for the quick turn. Wrapping up the items we committed to and suggested next steps below.

Summary of proposed approach (high level)
- Topology: EU primary + synchronous mirror (eu-west1) + APAC warm-standby staged seeding.
- Capacity: propose 2.0k reserved in EU + 1.5k burst pool for regional peaks; APAC initial seed at 25% of EU steady-state with a 60–90 day ramp.
- Failover: active-passive with geo-cache read-fallback (meets 5s metadata SLO) + KV rehydration window and a planned traffic-drain test in month 1 after cutover.
- Terms: 24-month renewal term recommended; one-time onboarding credit equal to 20% of month-1 reserved cost if they commit to the proposed EU reserved capacity.

Attachments & links
- Draft SOW (SOW-draft-v2.pdf) — includes capacity lines, canary windows, and KMS addendum option.
- Ops playbook (shared earlier) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-ops-handbook
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4931

2) Confirm the 2x peak assumption (is 2x p90 or 2x absolute peak).
3) Availability for a 30-min call Monday 2026-11-09 at 10:00 AM PT (David / Laura / Karthik / Monica to join).

If those three items look good, we'll send a DocuSign link for the SOW and share a rollout calendar with milestone owners.
